description: Get or set screen orientation. Can lock to portrait, landscape, reverse portrait, reverse landscape, or restore auto-rotate.

action.description: 'get' to read current orientation, 'set' to change it

orientation.description: Orientation to set (required when action='set'): auto=sensor, portrait=0°, landscape=90°, reverse_portrait=180°, reverse_landscape=270°

name: adb_orientation
